mechanism: A performer moves within a stable graphic layout. Her movement sits immediately beside the flat-token-to-physical-prop spill, though the source does not prove one gesture caused it. The sudden fall interrupts the routine; a brief recovery restores performance. The paper-theatre transfer adds an explicit sweep trigger as an original causal enhancement, not a claimed source fact. Preserve boundary crossing and reaction-repair, not the branded desktop.

invariants.rule: Establish one performer inside a stable graphic layout first.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without stable layout the spill looks like generic confetti.

invariants.rule: Place performer motion immediately beside flat tokens gaining mass and falling, without claiming the source proves a particular trigger gesture; a new transfer may make the trigger explicit.
invariants.purpose: Creates a readable graphic-to-physical surprise while preserving source uncertainty.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without motion adjacency the boundary break reads as unrelated decoration.

invariants.rule: Pause for reaction and recovery, then resume the same performer routine.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without repair and return this is only a VFX demonstration.

anti_copy_exclusions: No branded OS desktop, recognizable app icons or logo art.
No source person's face, costume or exact dance.

instantiations.concept: An adult paper-theatre performer sweeps a hand across an unbranded schedule board. Six printed circles become small weighted discs and fall to the floor. She pauses, collects them in a tray and resumes her puppet routine.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Paper theatre, schedule board, physical discs, tray recovery.

instantiations.concept: An adult museum guide points at an original projected star chart. Five plain glyphs become foam stars and drop onto a padded stage. She stacks them below the projection and resumes explaining.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Museum guide, projected stars, foam props, recovery.

failure_modes.repair: Show hand sweep and first detachment together.
